name: Shop Manager for WooCommerce – AI-Powered Frontend Dashboard & Smart Order, Product & Employee Management
author: Oxilab

sections.description:
Shop Manager for WooCommerce gives store owners and managers a clean, fast frontend dashboard to run their entire WooCommerce store, without needing access to the WordPress admin.

Whether you’re handling 10 orders a day or 500, the goal was simple: make WooCommerce management feel less like work. Every screen is built around what you actually need to do, create orders, update statuses, manage products, track customers, not what the database looks like on the inside.

✨ All Features | 💰 Upgrade to Pro | 📖 Documentation | 🆘 Support

Most WooCommerce store managers spend half their day inside the WordPress backend, an interface that was never really designed for high-volume order management. Shop Manager replaces that with a purpose-built frontend dashboard that’s fast, intuitive, and actually pleasant to use.

You get full order management, product management, a real-time analytics dashboard, and a customer CRM, all in one place. The Pro version also includes AI-powered tools that can write your product content, auto-tag your customers, and surface insights about your store.

🚀 Key Features

  • Frontend WooCommerce dashboard: manage your entire store without logging into the WordPress admin
  • Full order management: create, edit, delete, bulk-update, and export orders as CSV
  • Complete product management: add/edit products with variations, categories, brands, tags, attributes, and reviews
  • Real-time analytics: revenue, average order value, top products, and order trends, live, no 12-hour cache delay
  • Customer list & profiles: full purchase history, billing & shipping addresses, notes, order stats, and tags
  • Custom order statuses: create unlimited custom statuses with color presets that fit your exact workflow
  • AI chat assistant: ask questions about your store in plain language and get answers from live data, orders, revenue, products, customers, and employees
  • AI product content generator: write product titles, short descriptions, and full descriptions with one click
  • AI customer auto-tagging: automatically segments customers as VIP, Loyal, At Risk, Big Spender, Frequent, New, or Inactive
  • AI dashboard insight cards: plain-English summaries of what’s happening in your store right now
  • Your own AI keys: works with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Google Gemini; keys are AES-256 encrypted
  • CSV export: export product lists and order data for reporting, accounting, or migration
  • Built for WooCommerce HPOS: fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage

✅ Free Version Features

The free version covers the essentials, enough to manage a real store day to day:

✅ Frontend Dashboard: view your store at a glance without touching the WP admin
✅ Order list: search, filter, and view order details
✅ Bulk order actions + CSV export
✅ Create, edit, and delete products
✅ Product variations, categories, brands, tags, attributes, and reviews
✅ Real-time analytics: revenue, AOV, top products
✅ Customer list with purchase history
✅ Fully responsive: works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
✅ Employee management + role-based access: control who can see and do what
✅ Customer segmentation: filter customers by tag, spend, or behavior

🔥 Pro Version Features

Pro unlocks the full toolkit for growing stores:

✅ AI chat assistant: ask about your store in plain language, orders, revenue, products, customers, and employee activity, answered from live data
✅ AI product content generator: write product titles, short descriptions, and full descriptions with one click
✅ AI customer auto-tagging: automatically segments customers as VIP, Loyal, At Risk, Big Spender, Frequent, New, or Inactive
✅ AI dashboard insight cards: plain-English summaries of what’s happening in your store
✅ Multi-provider AI support: works with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and Google Gemini; bring your own API key
✅ Advanced order management: create, edit, and delete orders directly from the frontend
✅ Advanced order filters: filter by status, date, customer, and more
✅ Invoice PDF generation: generate and download professional invoices. Also send to customer with email
✅ Custom order statuses (unlimited): with color presets and visual workflow control
✅ Customer notes & communication log: keep track of interactions on every customer profile
✅ Priority email support: 12h response

👉 See full Free vs Pro comparison

🎯 Perfect For

  • 🏪 Store owners who don’t want to spend time in the WordPress admin every morning
  • 👩‍💼 Shop managers and employees who need to handle orders without full admin access
  • 👨‍💻 WooCommerce developers and agencies building client dashboards that clients can actually use
  • 📦 High-volume stores that need fast bulk actions and reliable status workflows
  • 🌍 Multi-language stores: built with WordPress i18n and translation-ready throughout

📈 Why Shop Manager

There are a handful of WooCommerce frontend manager plugins out there, but most of them were built years ago and show it. Shop Manager was designed from scratch, built with React, tested against real store workflows, and updated regularly.

Here is what actually sets it apart:

  • 🤖 AI tools built in: not a third-party integration; the product generator and customer tagging are part of the plugin. Bring your own API key for Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini and it just works.
  • ⚡ Real-time data: the dashboard pulls live data, not cached summaries from 12 hours ago
  • 🏷️ Smart customer tagging: customers are automatically segmented based on actual order behavior, not manual effort. Tags update when orders change.
  • 📋 Workflow-first order management: custom statuses, bulk actions, and CSV export are all designed around how fulfillment workflows actually work
  • 🔒 Secure by default: API keys are AES-256 encrypted, all REST endpoints are nonce-verified, and user access respects WooCommerce roles
  • 🔄 HPOS compatible: fully tested with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage, which is default in WooCommerce 8.0+
sections.installation:
⬇️ Option 1: Install from WordPress.org (Recommended)

  1. 🔑 Log into your WordPress admin
  2. 🔍 Go to Plugins > Add New and search for Shop Manager for WooCommerce
  3. 🖱️ Click Install Now, then Activate

📦 Option 2: Manual Upload

  1. ⬇️ Download the plugin zip from WordPress.org
  2. 📂 Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. 📤 Upload the zip file and click Install Now
  4. ✅ Click Activate Plugin

🚀 Getting Started

  1. After activation, go to Shop Manager in your WordPress admin sidebar
  2. The frontend dashboard shortcode [shop_manager] is available for embedding in any page
  3. To use AI features, go to Shop Manager > Admin > AI Settings and enter your API key
  4. Visit the Customer Settings tab to configure auto-tagging thresholds for your store
sections.faq:
🔌 Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Shop Manager is built entirely on top of WooCommerce and requires it to be installed and active. It is not compatible with other eCommerce plugins.

🤖 Do the AI features cost extra?

Shop Manager never charges extra for AI. The two AI features that generate content, the AI product content generator and the AI chat assistant, are Pro features, and you bring your own API key from Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), or Google (Gemini), so you only pay your provider for what you actually use, typically $1–5 per month for average stores. The rule-based smart features, customer auto-tagging and dashboard insight cards, work in every plan including free and don’t need an API key at all.

🔒 Is my API key stored securely?

Yes. API keys are encrypted with AES-256-CBC using your WordPress secret keys before being saved to the database. The raw key is never exposed in the browser, API responses, or log files.

⚡ Does it work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. Shop Manager is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), which became the default in WooCommerce 8.0.

🏷️ How does the AI customer auto-tagging work?

When an order is placed or its status changes, Shop Manager automatically recalculates tags for the customer based on their order history. Tags like VIP, Loyal, At Risk, and Big Spender are defined by thresholds you set in the admin settings, and you can adjust those thresholds at any time. Changing thresholds triggers a recalculation for all customers automatically.

🛒 Can I create and edit orders from the frontend?

The free version lets you view orders, run bulk actions, and export to CSV. Creating and editing orders from the frontend is a Pro feature.

👥 Can shop employees use this without admin access?

Yes. You can control who can access the frontend dashboard through WordPress role settings. The plugin respects the excluded roles configuration in the admin settings.

📱 Does it work on mobile?

The frontend dashboard is responsive and usable on mobile, though it is designed primarily for desktop use by store managers. All core workflows, order management, product editing, customer review, work on tablet and mobile.

🔄 What happens to existing data when I activate the plugin?

Nothing changes. Shop Manager reads your existing WooCommerce orders, products, and customers, it doesn’t create or migrate any data on activation.

🆓 Is there really a free version?

Yes. The free version includes the frontend dashboard, order viewing, bulk actions, product management, customer list, real-time analytics, and the AI tools (product generator, customer auto-tagging, insight cards). Pro unlocks advanced order creation, custom statuses, and the upcoming automation and compliance features.

🔑 Which AI providers are supported?

Shop Manager works with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI (GPT), and Google Gemini. You bring your own API key, so you only pay your provider for what you actually use, there’s no markup or subscription through Shop Manager.

🏷️ Can I create unlimited custom order statuses in the free version?

No. The free version lets you filter and manage your existing WooCommerce order statuses. Creating unlimited custom statuses, with color presets, is a Pro feature.

🧾 Does the invoice generator support multiple templates?

Yes. Invoice PDF generation is a Pro feature and includes four templates, Modern, Classic, Bold, and Minimal, so you can match your brand. Invoices can be downloaded individually or in bulk.

💾 Will my customer notes and tags be lost if I switch from Pro back to free?

No. Your data stays in your WooCommerce database either way. If you downgrade, Pro-only features like customer notes and unlimited custom statuses become read-only until you reactivate Pro, nothing is deleted.

🗑️ What happens to my orders and data if I deactivate or uninstall the plugin?

Deactivating keeps everything untouched, your orders, products, and customer data all live in WooCommerce’s own database, not in a separate table. Uninstalling removes only the plugin’s own settings and custom tags, your actual store data is never touched.

⚡ Does this plugin slow down my store?

No. Dashboard and analytics data is cached briefly to keep things fast, and AI features only run when you actively use them, they don’t run in the background or affect your storefront’s loading speed for customers.

🧩 Will this plugin conflict with other WooCommerce extensions like Subscriptions or Bookings?

Shop Manager works alongside standard WooCommerce order and product data, so it doesn’t override how other extensions handle their own custom order types. As with any plugin that touches order management, highly customized workflows are best tested on a staging site first.

🔌 What happens if I don’t add an AI API key?

Everything except the AI product content generator and the AI chat assistant works normally. Customer auto-tagging, insight cards, orders, products, customers, and employee management are all unaffected, since those don’t call any AI provider. You only need a key for the two features that generate or answer with AI.

👥 Can multiple employees see different parts of the dashboard at the same time?

Yes. Role-based access is per-user, so two employees logged in at the same time each see only what their role allows, one might manage orders while another only views products, based on the permissions you set.
sections.changelog:
1.3.3

  • 🆕 New: Product add-on and personalisation fields now show in order details. Any data a third-party add-on plugin writes to a line item — customer-entered names, uploaded artwork, selected options — appears in the order page, in the expandable row on the Orders list, and on the invoice PDF. Previously only variation attributes were shown, so everything else was dropped. This works with WooCommerce Product Add-Ons Ultimate, Gravity Forms Product Add-Ons, Checkout Field Editor and any other plugin that stores line item meta, because Shop Manager now renders it through WooCommerce’s own formatter rather than a fixed list of keys.
  • 🆕 New: “Product Add-ons & Options” toggle under Invoice → Columns controls whether those item details are printed on the invoice and packing slip. On by default.
  • 🐛 Fix: Editing an order no longer destroys product add-on data. Saving an order from the dashboard — even a change to nothing but the shipping address — deleted and recreated every line item, which permanently discarded all add-on, personalisation and subscription meta attached to them. Line items are now updated in place, and only items you actually remove are deleted.
  • 🐛 Fix: Line item details were hidden on simple products. The order page only rendered item meta for variable products, so personalised options on a simple product were invisible even when present.
  • 🐛 Fix: Removing the discount from an order left an orphaned fee row behind in some cases; fee items are now removed through the order object so the change is written correctly.

1.3.2

  • 🆕 New: Dashboard branding. Upload your own logo for the frontend dashboard from Appearance → Branding, with separate slots for light mode, dark mode and the collapsed sidebar icon. Each slot falls back to the Shop Manager logo when left empty, and the dark slot reuses your light logo if you only upload one.
  • ✨ Improvement: Appearance tab reorganised. Settings are grouped into labelled cards (Branding, Layout Style, Color Combination, Dark Mode Style), and all three pickers now share one selection style with hover, focus and keyboard support.
  • ✨ Improvement: The frontend sidebar header now shows your dashboard logo in place of the plugin name and version text.
  • ✨ Improvement: AI Settings lists the current Claude models (Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5 and Haiku 4.5), with Claude Sonnet 5 as the default. A model you saved earlier is still listed, so an existing choice is never lost.
  • ✨ Improvement: AI Chatbot settings are configurable without the Pro plugin. The screen is no longer replaced by an upgrade notice — access to the assistant itself is still controlled from the frontend dashboard.
  • ✨ Improvement: Employee Management, AI Chatbot and AI Settings rebuilt on one shared layout — label and description on the left, control on the right, grouped into consistent cards — so every settings screen reads the same way.
  • ✨ Improvement: Employee Management, AI Chatbot and AI Settings are now fully translatable; those screens previously contained hard-coded English text.
  • 🐛 Fix: The WordPress admin settings panel no longer changes with the frontend dashboard’s Color Combination, Preset or Dark Mode. Those settings style the frontend dashboard only; the admin screen now renders with a fixed theme. Previously, switching the frontend to dark mode also put wp-admin into a dark palette while its own styling stayed light.
  • 🐛 Fix: SVG icons lost their viewBox during the build, so any icon rendered at a size other than its original was cropped instead of scaled. Most visible on the collapsed sidebar icon, which showed only a corner of the logo.
  • 🐛 Fix: In dark mode on the frontend dashboard, the avatar dropdown chevron and the order status slider arrows kept a hard-coded light background.
  • 🐛 Fix: Labels and controls on several settings screens were centred instead of left aligned, because a shared card style was missing its text-alignment reset.
  • 🐛 Fix: The AI Chatbot settings rendered a form nested inside the main settings form, which is invalid markup; the redundant inner forms have been removed.
  • 🐛 Fix: Clicking the company logo upload box in Invoice settings did nothing; the WordPress media library scripts were never loaded on the Shop Manager settings screen, so the media modal could not open.
  • 🐛 Fix: The “Change” and “Remove” logo buttons in Invoice settings submitted the settings form and showed the “Settings saved successfully” message; they now only open the media library or clear the logo, and settings save exclusively via the Save Changes button.

1.3.1

  • 🔒 Security: Fixed a broken function-level authorization flaw in the shop-manager/v1 REST API where any built-in Shop Manager employee role could reach every endpoint regardless of its assigned module permissions. Each customer, order, product, analytics, and employee route now enforces its specific per-role capability server-side (e.g. oxi_sm_view_customers, oxi_sm_edit_orders, oxi_sm_view_employees). A product-only employee can no longer read or modify customer, order, or employee-access data. Thanks to security researcher an7ln for the responsible disclosure.
  • 🔒 Security: The global dashboard search endpoint (which returns order and customer data) now requires the “view orders” capability.
  • 🔒 Security: Server-side REST capability checks now honor both the default roles’ coarse capabilities and custom roles’ granular per-section capabilities (categories, tags, brands, attributes, reviews, roles & access), matching the frontend permission model so that each employee sees exactly the pages and data their role allows — no more, no less.
  • 🐛 Fix: Employees without dashboard access no longer land on an “Access Restricted” screen after logging in; the dashboard now redirects them to the first page their role can actually access (e.g. a product-only employee lands on Products).
  • 🐛 Fix: Custom employee roles granted access to a specific product section (e.g. Categories) but not full product access could not load that section’s data (“You are not allowed to access this resource”); section-level permissions are now correctly recognized by the REST API.

short_description: AI-powered WooCommerce Frontend Order Manager to manage orders, products, employees, and customers without wp-admin.
description:
Shop Manager for WooCommerce gives store owners and managers a clean, fast frontend dashboard to run their entire WooCommerce store, without needing access to the WordPress admin.

Whether you’re handling 10 orders a day or 500, the goal was simple: make WooCommerce management feel less like work. Every screen is built around what you actually need to do, create orders, update statuses, manage products, track customers, not what the database looks like on the inside.

✨ All Features | 💰 Upgrade to Pro | 📖 Documentation | 🆘 Support

Most WooCommerce store managers spend half their day inside the WordPress backend, an interface that was never really designed for high-volume order management. Shop Manager replaces that with a purpose-built frontend dashboard that’s fast, intuitive, and actually pleasant to use.

You get full order management, product management, a real-time analytics dashboard, and a customer CRM, all in one place. The Pro version also includes AI-powered tools that can write your product content, auto-tag your customers, and surface insights about your store.

🚀 Key Features

  • Frontend WooCommerce dashboard: manage your entire store without logging into the WordPress admin
  • Full order management: create, edit, delete, bulk-update, and export orders as CSV
  • Complete product management: add/edit products with variations, categories, brands, tags, attributes, and reviews
  • Real-time analytics: revenue, average order value, top products, and order trends, live, no 12-hour cache delay
  • Customer list & profiles: full purchase history, billing & shipping addresses, notes, order stats, and tags
  • Custom order statuses: create unlimited custom statuses with color presets that fit your exact workflow
  • AI chat assistant: ask questions about your store in plain language and get answers from live data, orders, revenue, products, customers, and employees
  • AI product content generator: write product titles, short descriptions, and full descriptions with one click
  • AI customer auto-tagging: automatically segments customers as VIP, Loyal, At Risk, Big Spender, Frequent, New, or Inactive
  • AI dashboard insight cards: plain-English summaries of what’s happening in your store right now
  • Your own AI keys: works with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Google Gemini; keys are AES-256 encrypted
  • CSV export: export product lists and order data for reporting, accounting, or migration
  • Built for WooCommerce HPOS: fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage

✅ Free Version Features

The free version covers the essentials, enough to manage a real store day to day:

✅ Frontend Dashboard: view your store at a glance without touching the WP admin
✅ Order list: search, filter, and view order details
✅ Bulk order actions + CSV export
✅ Create, edit, and delete products
✅ Product variations, categories, brands, tags, attributes, and reviews
✅ Real-time analytics: revenue, AOV, top products
✅ Customer list with purchase history
✅ Fully responsive: works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
✅ Employee management + role-based access: control who can see and do what
✅ Customer segmentation: filter customers by tag, spend, or behavior

🔥 Pro Version Features

Pro unlocks the full toolkit for growing stores:

✅ AI chat assistant: ask about your store in plain language, orders, revenue, products, customers, and employee activity, answered from live data
✅ AI product content generator: write product titles, short descriptions, and full descriptions with one click
✅ AI customer auto-tagging: automatically segments customers as VIP, Loyal, At Risk, Big Spender, Frequent, New, or Inactive
✅ AI dashboard insight cards: plain-English summaries of what’s happening in your store
✅ Multi-provider AI support: works with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and Google Gemini; bring your own API key
✅ Advanced order management: create, edit, and delete orders directly from the frontend
✅ Advanced order filters: filter by status, date, customer, and more
✅ Invoice PDF generation: generate and download professional invoices. Also send to customer with email
✅ Custom order statuses (unlimited): with color presets and visual workflow control
✅ Customer notes & communication log: keep track of interactions on every customer profile
✅ Priority email support: 12h response

👉 See full Free vs Pro comparison

🎯 Perfect For

  • 🏪 Store owners who don’t want to spend time in the WordPress admin every morning
  • 👩‍💼 Shop managers and employees who need to handle orders without full admin access
  • 👨‍💻 WooCommerce developers and agencies building client dashboards that clients can actually use
  • 📦 High-volume stores that need fast bulk actions and reliable status workflows
  • 🌍 Multi-language stores: built with WordPress i18n and translation-ready throughout

📈 Why Shop Manager

There are a handful of WooCommerce frontend manager plugins out there, but most of them were built years ago and show it. Shop Manager was designed from scratch, built with React, tested against real store workflows, and updated regularly.

Here is what actually sets it apart:

  • 🤖 AI tools built in: not a third-party integration; the product generator and customer tagging are part of the plugin. Bring your own API key for Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini and it just works.
  • ⚡ Real-time data: the dashboard pulls live data, not cached summaries from 12 hours ago
  • 🏷️ Smart customer tagging: customers are automatically segmented based on actual order behavior, not manual effort. Tags update when orders change.
  • 📋 Workflow-first order management: custom statuses, bulk actions, and CSV export are all designed around how fulfillment workflows actually work
  • 🔒 Secure by default: API keys are AES-256 encrypted, all REST endpoints are nonce-verified, and user access respects WooCommerce roles
  • 🔄 HPOS compatible: fully tested with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage, which is default in WooCommerce 8.0+
